body:
Ahoy, shipmate!

The summer winds are fair, and this week my ship sails along the coast to the fishing villages. Will you sail with me?

Come down the coast road to the harbour. First, we load the provisions!
summary: Load provisions for Captain Mara's voyage.

tasks.where: at the coast (walk the coast road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
